# Tally

> Tally is private bilateral trade credit on Midnight. Amount and due stay in witnesses. Settled loans mint a relationship leaf. A membership proof answers yes or no only.

Live desk: https://tally-jet-mu.vercel.app
Network: Midnight Preprod
Contract: 84c44946900ca4ad4456518b09a42c01424dd8b626797310c5ed5b4b933b10af

## Use Tally

- [Introduction](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/index.mdx): what Tally is, the pipeline, and how to start.
- [How it works](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/how-it-works.mdx): Offer → Accept → Disburse → Repay → Settle → Prove standing.
- [Privacy](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/privacy.mdx): what the public ledger sees, what it never sees, what a verifier learns.
- [Desk tour](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/desk-tour.mdx): Local vs Preprod, Lace/1AM, Lender / Borrower / Verifier.
- [Local quickstart](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/quickstart.mdx): full circuit path in about ten minutes, no wallet.
- [Preprod guide](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/preprod.mdx): join the contract, wallets, proof server, faucet.

## Build on Tally

- [Architecture](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/architecture.mdx): leaderboard-ui, api, contract, proof-server — what you inherit vs what you build.
- [Contract reference](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/contract.mdx): offerLoan, acceptLoan, disburse, repay, settle, proveStanding.
- [Identity](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/identity.mdx): secret + PIN Desk ID. Not ownPublicKey().
- [Design system](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/design-system.mdx): tokens and rejection list for contributors.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/contributing.mdx): Node 22, Compact 0.31, test and run.
- [Demo video](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/demo.mdx): silent desk walkthrough (Offer → Verifier Pass). File: [Tally-Demo-Silent.mp4](https://github.com/Preciousbas/tally/blob/main/docs/demo/Tally-Demo-Silent.mp4).
